spanish: Desde fuera a la parójet del testimonio en tienda de reunión lo ordenará Aarón desde tarde hasta mañana delante de Jehová siempre; estatuto de siempre a generaciones de ustedes.

findings.issue: Common noun (feminine singular construct, not a proper name) is left as the untranslated Hebraism parójet instead of Spanish.
Distinct lemmas, continual regularity and perpetual duration, are both rendered siempre.
Evening noun is rendered tarde, which in current Latin American Spanish is afternoon and may widen the time.

notes: Person, number, prepositions, object suffix, and 2mp as ustedes otherwise match the tokens.
